_comment: Catalog of ready-to-use real datasets. Add your own entries here (or from the app sidebar). kind = sqlite | csv | excel. For csv/excel, each file becomes a table.

datasets.name: Chinook — digital music store
datasets.description: Real-world-style iTunes store: artists, albums, tracks, genres, playlists, customers, employees and invoices (2009–2013). 11 tables.
examples: Which 5 artists have generated the most revenue?
Show total sales by year
Which countries have the most customers, and how much do they spend?
Which sales support agent brought in the most revenue?

datasets.name: Northwind — trading company
datasets.description: Classic Microsoft sample for a food import/export business: customers, orders, order details (600k+ lines), products, suppliers, employees, shippers, territories.
examples: What are the top 10 best-selling products by revenue?
Show monthly order count for the last 2 years in the data
Which employee handled the most orders?
Which suppliers provide products in the Beverages category?

datasets.name: Sakila — DVD rental chain
datasets.description: MySQL's official sample database ported to SQLite: films, actors, categories, inventory, stores, staff, customers, rentals and payments.
examples: Which film categories earn the most rental revenue?
Who are the 10 most frequently rented actors?
Compare revenue between the two stores by month
Which customers have rented more than 40 films?

datasets.name: Titanic passengers
datasets.description: Passenger list of the RMS Titanic (891 passengers): class, sex, age, fare, port of embarkation and survival.
examples: What was the survival rate by passenger class and sex?
What is the age distribution of passengers?
Did passengers who paid higher fares survive more often?
How many passengers embarked from each port?

datasets.name: COVID-19 by country (Our World in Data)
datasets.description: Latest cumulative COVID-19 cases, deaths, vaccinations, population and development indicators per country and region.
examples: Which 10 countries had the highest deaths per million?
Compare total cases per million across continents
Is there a relationship between GDP per capita and vaccination rate?
Show India's key COVID figures

datasets.name: Restaurant tips
datasets.description: Bills and tips recorded by a waiter: total bill, tip, party size, day, time, smoker.
examples: What is the average tip percentage by day?
Do smokers tip more than non-smokers?
How does tip amount relate to bill size?
Which party size has the highest average bill?
